run_visualizer_interactive: run the StyleNeRF interactive visualizer with a pretrained model pickle file
run_visualizer_with_capture: run the visualizer with a capture directory to save screenshot captures
run_visualizer_with_browse_dir: run the visualizer with a custom browse directory for the Browse button
load_pickle_model: load a specific model pickle file into the visualizer for rendering
add_recent_pickle: add a model pickle path to the visualizer recent pickles list
